Name: Owljoy Lunchboxes
Author: OwlandJoy
Description:
[b][color=#e69138][size=5]Owljoy Lunchboxes[/size][/color][/b]
[i]Carry your favourite meals wherever you go![/i]
[b]Owljoy Lunchboxes adds eight unique portable lunchboxes that let you store food and drinks separately from your inventory. Whether you're spending the day in the mines, fishing by the river, or exploring Ginger Island, your meals will always be ready when you need them.[/b]
[heading][color=#f6b26b]
Features[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*] 8  lunchboxes[/*]
[*] Store food and drinks in portable lunchboxes [/*]
[*] Contents are saved automatically [/*]
[*] Only food and drinks can be stored[/*]
[*]Available for purchase at Pierre's General Store[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#e69138]
How to Use[/color][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Purchase a lunchbox from Pierre's General Store. [/*]
[*]Hold the lunchbox and right-click to open it. [/*]
[*]Place your food and drinks inside. [/*]
[*]Close the lunchbox and take it with you wherever you go. [/*]
[/list]Your stored items will remain safely inside the lunchbox, even after saving and loading your game.
[heading][color=#f6b26b]
Requirements[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ [/*]
[*]SMAPI [/*]
[/list][heading][color=#e69138]
Compatibility[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]Compatible with multiplayer. [/*]
[*]Works alongside most mods. [/*]
[*]Does not require Content Patcher or other framework mods. [/*]
[*][b][color=#ff0000]Android Compatibility[/color]:[/b]  Lunchbox contents may appear empty on Android even though the stored items are still present and visible to PC players. This appears to be a display/synchronisation issue and is being investigated. [/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][color=#f9cb9c]Optional Cosmetic Collection 🍃✨[/color]
[color=#e4e4e7][size=2]Looking for more lunchbox designs? :D[/size][/color][/heading]
I've released my first optional cosmetic content packs, [b]Vintage Lunchboxes[/b] & [b]Picnic Charm Lunchboxes.[/b]
The collections are purely cosmetic and works with Owljoy Lunchboxes, giving you even more styles to choose from while keeping the same gameplay.
If you'd like to support my work, you can find it on my Ko-fi. ☕
[heading][color=#ea9999]
Thank You!! [/color]
[color=#e4e4e7][size=2]Thank you for downloading Owljoy Lunchboxes! I hope it makes your adventures around Stardew Valley a little more organised.[/size][/color][/heading]
If you enjoy the mod and would like to support future updates and new cosmetic collections, you can always[b][color=#ffe599] [url=https://ko-fi.com/owljoy/shop][i]buy me a coffee on Ko-fi[/i][/url][/color][/b]. The support means a lot and helps me continue creating mods for the community 🌼.
